notes: Read all 288 source lines (numbered) before editing. This widget's sibling primitives (./WidgetShell L11, ./types WidgetProps L12) and @/components/feedback EmptyState (L5) are not yet in the native manifest, so per the BatteryGaugeWidget/ChargeStatusWidget inline-reproduction precedent they are ported self-contained here; the real hook (useVehicles L6), the converted client (request L8) and the converted types (Drive L13) are imported from their canonical native files. React Native has no SVG primitive, so the web SVG HeatmapGrid is rebuilt as a flexbox View grid following the converted RadialGauge + sibling CostHeatmap View-grid precedent.

No DOM elements, lucide-react, react-i18next, Recharts, Leaflet, react-router, or old web UI components are imported into the native output — only react, react-native (View/Pressable/StyleSheet + StyleProp/TextStyle types), @tanstack/react-query, the canonical AppText/GlassPanel/SemanticIcon, the converted parity hooks/client/types (useVehicles/useSettings/request/Drive), and theme tokens. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest) all pass; the web-parity tree is independent of the existing apps/native test set.
